svg.title: Reflectance sensor → Arduino Uno
svg.desc: Realistic Fritzing Uno R3 and FC-51 module. Red connects Arduino 5V to VCC; black connects GND to GND; blue connects D2 to OUT.
svg.text: FC-51 sensor • physical pin locations • Arduino powered by USB
Connections at the actual labeled pins
Unplug USB before changing wires. Wire crossings are not junctions.
